newsitem.title: TURKEY: Seven die, 21 hurt in Turkish gas cannister blast.
newsitem.headline: Seven die, 21 hurt in Turkish gas cannister blast.

text.p: Seven people died and 21 were injured on Monday after household gas cannisters exploded in a town in southeastern Turkey, police officials told Reuters.

The blast, in Cizre in the province Sirnak, started a fire which spead to another house and set off a further gas cannister explosion there, an official said. The injured, mostly women and children, were taken to hospital.
